\par\smallskip{\footnotesize\raggedright\textit{Note.} All rates in \%. Parsed and schema valid: share of all 144 cases (an unparseable artifact counts as invalid). Trap-failure rate: share of parseable risk cases with a gold trap failure (\texttt{trapFellAny}: a trap signature on the supported side, a trap requirement marked supported against the gold status, or a family-specific extra rule of the decision and subjective families), Wilson 95\% CI, k/n in parentheses. Trap routing: share of parseable risk cases in which the trap did not fire and was routed (decision family: no trap failure; subjective family: every gold subjective source appears in \texttt{interviewSignalRisks}; other families: the trap requirement appears in \texttt{missingEvidenceGaps} or \texttt{followUpQuestions}, or a trap signature appears in \texttt{unsupportedClaims}). Retention: mean over parseable matched controls of the share of gold valid-claim signatures that appear anywhere on the supported side (lenient). Bundle flags: cases whose bundle-level validator verdict is BLOCK or HUMAN\_REVIEW, out of 72 risk cases or 72 controls (unparseable counts as flagged); for C0, C1, C2 and C5 this is an offline validation after generation, not an intervention; bundle flags are not a detection metric. C3 = the C2 artifacts plus a validation report, so its artifact metrics equal C2's. C4 = deterministic post-processing of the frozen C2 artifacts (validation, one repair pass, at most one regeneration); its residual critical-violation rate (0.0\%) and schema validity (100.0\%) follow from all final artifacts being non-BLOCK in these runs and are shown as --.\par}
